name: Boccali Vineyard & Winery Tomato Festival & Wine Tasting
description: Boccali Vineyard & Winery Tomato Festival & Wine Tasting is an agritourism farm in 3201 Ojai Santa Paula Road, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
